info.title: QODIQA API — Public API
info.description: Public developer subset of the QODIQA HTTP contract, generated from docs/api/openapi.json and deploy/public-api/public-operations.json by scripts/openapi/public-subset.js. Administrative, operational and unversioned routes are not part of the public API.

get.description: the public keys of the audit-checkpoint signing key store (a separate trust domain from the artifact and transparency keys), for independent verification of signed audit-chain checkpoints and of audit.log.base.json.
IANA well-known endpoint for public key discovery (JWKS format).

archived-key discovery endpoint — artifact-signing keys that have been purged from the live keystore (see /.well-known/qodiqa/keys) but remain published here so historical artifacts stay verifiable indefinitely. Independently and more strictly rate limited than the live discovery endpoint.

200.description: Transparency log public key set (JWK format)

get.description: IANA well-known endpoint for transparency-log Merkle root signing key discovery (JWKS format), distinct from the artifact-signing key set at /.well-known/qodiqa/keys.

400.description: Invalid sign request (INVALID_REQUEST, PROVIDER_REQUIRED, PROVIDER_NOT_SUPPORTED, PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED)

401.description: Signing credential missing, unknown or expired (UNAUTHORIZED, API_KEY_EXPIRED)

post.description:
Generate a signed artifact for a request.

Refusals are BLOCK decision bodies (`DecisionBlock`). A 503 is either the shutdown-drain body or, when the signing key or the policy set is unavailable, a `DecisionBlock` with reason `KEY_UNAVAILABLE` or `POLICY_UNAVAILABLE`.

The artifact can then be passed as `x-qodiqa-artifact` when executing via `/ai/chat`
or verified independently via `/verify`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <signing-api-key>` — a per-identity credential
issued via `POST /signing-identities/{id}/api-key` (TRUST-1 remediation; there is
no shared signing secret). The authenticated identity determines which tenant's
signing key is used and which environment/providers the artifact may target.

TTL defaults to 60 s (60 000 ms), the maximum artifact age: a larger value is clamped to 60 s
(reported in `meta.ttlClamped` / `meta.effectiveTtlMs`), a value below 1 s is raised to 1 s, and the
authenticated identity's own maxTtlMs can only lower it (API-07; previously documented as 5 min / [1 s, 24 h]).

200.description: Enforcement decision. `decision: "EXECUTE"` (request executed), or — in the DEFAULT `decision` mode (QODIQA_BLOCK_HTTP_MODE unset or `decision`) — `decision: "BLOCK"` with the `reason` that stopped it. Clients MUST read `decision`; HTTP 200 alone does not mean the request executed. With `stream: true` an executing request answers `text/event-stream` instead (a BLOCK decided before the stream opens is still this JSON body).

Idempotency-Key.description: Echo of the request `Idempotency-Key`, when one was sent and accepted.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: `true` when this response is the stored result of an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key` (only `requestId` is re-stamped); absent otherwise.

schema.description: Server-sent events (docs/architecture/streaming.md). Each frame is `event: <name>` (absent on `[DONE]`) + `id: <streamId>:<seq>` + `data: <JSON>`; the first frame also sends `retry: 3000`. Clients should read `data:`; the JSON payload repeats the `event` name. Event objects carry `event`: `stream_started`, then zero or more `chunk_forwarded` (`delta` = released output text), then exactly one terminal `stream_completed` or `stream_cancelled` (`reason`, e.g. SEMANTIC_OUTPUT_BLOCKED, OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE, STREAM_TIMEOUT, CLIENT_DISCONNECT, a provider error code), followed by the literal `data: [DONE]`. Output is released in semantic-window bursts after it has been classified; the stream is not resumable (no Last-Event-ID support) and an artifact cannot be reused to reconnect.

400.description: `status` mode only: enforcement BLOCK for a missing or unreadable artifact (MISSING_ARTIFACT, ARTIFACT_DECODE_FAILED, …). In both modes: request-body input-guard failures (canonical error envelope).

403.description: `status` mode only (QODIQA_BLOCK_HTTP_MODE=status): enforcement BLOCK (`decision: "BLOCK"`) for an invalid artifact, request mismatch, anomaly, consent, policy, tenant/identity, semantic or output-limit reason. The `reason` field identifies the cause (docs/protocol/QODIQA-PROTOCOL.md). In the default mode these are HTTP 200.

409.description: `REPLAY_DETECTED` (the artifact nonce was already used; `status` mode only — HTTP 200 in the default mode), or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT` / `IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS` (both modes: the `Idempotency-Key` was reused with a different request, or its first request is still running).

413.description: Both modes: `ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE` (the `x-qodiqa-artifact` header exceeds 8 KB) or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_TOO_LARGE` (the `Idempotency-Key` exceeds its length cap).

415.description: Both modes: `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` — the request `Content-Type` is not `application/json`.

422.description: Both modes: `AUDIT_UNREPRESENTABLE_TEXT` — the request or provider output contains a value the evidence stores cannot represent (U+0000, a lone surrogate); refused before any partial audit record is written.

502.description: Both modes: `PROVIDER_RESPONSE_INVALID` — the AI provider returned a response that could not be used.

504.description: Both modes: `PROVIDER_TIMEOUT`, `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` (the pipeline exceeded AI_CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS) or `PROVIDER_CANCELLED`. The outcome is unknown to the client; a retry needs a freshly signed artifact (an `Idempotency-Key` makes the retry exactly-once).

post.description:
Execute an AI request through the QODIQA enforcement pipeline.

The enforcement pipeline performs:
1. Artifact signature verification (Ed25519)
2. Request binding validation
3. Nonce replay protection
4. Anomaly detection
5. Policy evaluation
6. AI provider execution (if allowed)

Returns `decision: "EXECUTE"`, or `decision: "BLOCK"` if any pipeline step rejects the request. In the default `decision` mode both are HTTP 200 (read `decision`, not the status); in the opt-in `status` mode a BLOCK carries its class status (400/403/409/429/500/503). Retrying with the same artifact after the nonce was consumed answers REPLAY_DETECTED; only a 503 SERVER_OVERLOADED (admission control, before nonce registration) leaves the artifact reusable.

The request **must** include a signed artifact in the `x-qodiqa-artifact` header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Opaque client token, printable non-whitespace ASCII; maximum length 255 by default (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MAX_LENGTH).

parameters.description: Optional exactly-once retry token (docs/architecture/IDEMPOTENCY_KEY.md). Rejected with `stream: true` (`IDEMPOTENCY_STREAMING_UNSUPPORTED`).

The enforcement pipeline performs:
1. Artifact signature verification (Ed25519)
2. Request binding validation

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Opaque client token, printable non-whitespace ASCII; maximum length 255 by default (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MAX_LENGTH).

parameters.description: Optional exactly-once retry token (docs/architecture/IDEMPOTENCY_KEY.md). Rejected with `stream: true` (`IDEMPOTENCY_STREAMING_UNSUPPORTED`).

200.description: RFC 6962 consistency proof that tree(fromRoot) is a cryptographic prefix of tree(toRoot). verification.valid is true only when the hash relation verifies AND both roots' signatures authenticate under active/deprecated transparency keys (FROM_ROOT_SIGNATURE, TO_ROOT_SIGNATURE checks; an unusable key store is SKIP and not valid); structurallyValid and authenticated report the two halves separately
Entry list (pagination metadata flat beside the list — src/utils/pagination.js withPaginationMeta)

Merkle inclusion proof (proof is null with a message until a root covers the entry). proofVerification.valid is true only when the proof verifies structurally AND the entry and covering-root signatures authenticate under active/deprecated transparency keys (ENTRY_SIGNATURE, ROOT_SIGNATURE checks; an unusable key store is SKIP and not valid)

get.summary: Get the signed receipt of a decision

200.description: The receipt stored for that request (the body is the receipt and nothing else: no tenant, no reason). Receipts are kept for a bounded retrieval window (QODIQA_RECEIPT_TTL_SECONDS, default 3600 s); after it the answer is 404 and the durable evidence is the transparency inclusion proof
Latest signed root, or the root named by ?rootId (root is null with a message before the first root)
Root history, newest first (pagination metadata flat beside the list)

post.description:
Verify a signed artifact without executing the underlying request.

Performs the complete 5-step verification pipeline in dry-run mode:
1. Ed25519 signature verification
2. Request binding verification
3. Nonce check (dry-run, no state write)
4. Anomaly detection (dry-run)
5. Policy evaluation

Returns HTTP 200 with `decision: "EXECUTE"` or `decision: "BLOCK"`. No AI provider is called.

requestBody.description: Artifact and original request to verify

post.summary: Verify artifact (v1, v2 rate limit tier)
post.description:
Verify a signed artifact without executing the underlying request.

Performs the complete 5-step verification pipeline in dry-run mode:
1. Ed25519 signature verification
2. Request binding verification
3. Nonce check (dry-run, no state write)
4. Anomaly detection (dry-run)
5. Policy evaluation

Returns HTTP 200 with `decision: "EXECUTE"` or `decision: "BLOCK"`. No AI provider is called.

Identical verification pipeline to /verify, exposed under a separate, independently configurable rate limit for higher-volume callers.

requestBody.description: Artifact and original request to verify

OffsetParam.name: offset
OffsetParam.description: Deprecated alias for `page` (0-based item offset, honored exactly even when not page-aligned). Prefer `page`.

PageSizeParam.name: pageSize
PageSizeParam.description: Items per page (1–500). Canonical pagination parameter.

ReceiptRequestIdParam.name: requestId
ReceiptRequestIdParam.description: The payload.requestId of the consumed artifact (a UUID). Knowing it is the only authorization for this endpoint.

BadRequest.description: Bad request — validation error or malformed input (canonical error envelope, src/api/response.js buildFailureBody)

error.message: body.actor_id must be a non-empty string

InternalError.description: Internal server error (src/api/response.js handleUnexpectedError; never the raw error message)

NotFound.description: Not found — resource does not exist

ServiceShuttingDown.description: Service is shutting down. Returned by the request-drain middleware (`src/runtime/requestDrain.js`), mounted ahead of every route below, for all new requests received after graceful shutdown has begun. In-flight requests are still allowed to complete.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests. The body depends on the rate-limit bucket's configured envelope (src/core/rateLimit/middleware.js _deny429): management and legacyFailure buckets send the canonical error envelope; the protocol-decision bucket sends the BLOCK decision body; protocol buckets send the flat limiter body.

schema.description: Seconds until the bucket allows another request

prompt.description: Prompt text. Limit: 32 768 UTF-8 BYTES (-> 400 PROMPT_TOO_LARGE) - multi-byte characters count more than once, so maxLength (characters) is only an upper bound. Missing, non-string or whitespace-only -> 400 MISSING_PROMPT.
prompt.example: Summarise the latest EU AI Act requirements.

provider.description: Accepted; the provider is taken from the signed artifact, not from this field

messages.description: A multi-turn conversation INSTEAD of prompt: 1..50 messages, each content 1..32 768 UTF-8 bytes, whole conversation <= 131 072 bytes, the LAST message is role user. Every message is part of the signed request body, so changing, adding, dropping or reordering a turn after signing invalidates the artifact; every role is screened (the evidence names the role and position). Not allowed together with prompt (400 PROMPT_AND_MESSAGES). QODIQA_MULTI_TURN_ENABLED=false refuses it again.

system.description: System instruction, becomes the first message; only with messages.

purpose.description: the purpose the caller DECLARES for this request ([A-Za-z0-9._:/ -]). A claim, not a proof: policy rules may require one (ABAC_PURPOSE_NOT_DECLARED) but QODIQA cannot verify it.

dataRegion.description: the region the caller DECLARES the data comes from (same character set). A claim, not a proof.

AiChatRequest.description: Either prompt or messages (+ optional system). Refused fields (400 UNSUPPORTED_FIELD, named in the error; on a streaming request the tool fields give 400 STREAM_TOOLS_UNSUPPORTED): tools, tool_choice, functions, function_call, response_format. Any other unknown field is accepted and ignored.

policyHash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the policy set at signing time (informational)

payload.description: Signed payload; a plain object with no undefined values

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, canonical standard base64 (exactly 88 characters ending "==")

reason.description: Machine-readable reason code; see the top-level `x-qodiqa-error-catalog` (API-09/API-10).

decision.description: Enforcement decision — always inspect this field, never the HTTP status alone. The dry-run verification endpoints (/verify, /v1/verify) return this body with HTTP 200 for both EXECUTE and BLOCK. The enforcement endpoints (/ai/chat, /v1/ai/chat, and their /stream variants) also return HTTP 200 for an enforcement BLOCK in the DEFAULT `decision` mode (QODIQA_BLOCK_HTTP_MODE unset or `decision`, src/api/blockHttpStatus.js); only in the opt-in `status` mode does a BLOCK carry its class status (400 malformed artifact, 403 invalid artifact/consent/policy/semantic, 409 replay, 429 policy rate rule, 500 internal, 503 dependency unavailable — docs/protocol/QODIQA-PROTOCOL.md). Transport throttles (429 RATE_LIMITED), input-guard 400s, 413, provider errors (502/503/504) are non-200 in both modes.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason code. Every BLOCK reason, its class, its status-mode HTTP status and whether it is retryable are listed in the top-level `x-qodiqa-error-catalog` (API-09/API-10). The set is open: a reason not listed there is still a denial (status mode: 403).

oneOf.description: Per-HTTP trace id (the same value as the `X-Request-ID` response header). Not the artifact id: to look up the audit record (GET /audit/{artifactId}) use the `artifactId` returned by POST /sign.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Protocol/enforcement codes are listed in the top-level `x-qodiqa-error-catalog`; management-API codes are route-specific (API-10).

message.example: body.policy must be a plain object

path.description: At most 2048 UTF-8 BYTES (-> 400 PATH_TOO_LONG); maxLength here is the character bound only

body.description: Required. The exact JSON body to be bound (use {} for a request without a body); at most 10 levels deep (-> 400 BODY_TOO_DEEP)

query.description: Protocol V2 only (needs a v2 block): the raw query string WITHOUT the leading "?", bound into the artifact. A raw "+" or ";" is refused with 400 QUERY_NOT_BINDABLE — write %20, %2B, %3B.

headers.description: Protocol V2 only (needs a v2 block): the values of the headers named in v2.bind.headers (lower-case names); a header not listed there is refused.

payload.description: Optional additional payload. The name "qodiqa" (and any look-alike) is reserved: 400 RESERVED_CLAIM; caller data may be put under "claims" in a V2 artifact.

headers.description: Names of the request headers whose values are bound (lower-case; none of x-qodiqa-artifact, authorization, proxy-authorization, cookie, set-cookie, host, content-length, transfer-encoding, connection, keep-alive, te, trailer, upgrade, via, forwarded, x-forwarded-for). May be empty.

oneOf.description: The one model this artifact authorizes; /ai/chat refuses a body that names another (REQUEST_MISMATCH).

maxTokens.description: Caps the provider output for this request (enforced by the provider adapters, streaming included). maxCostMicros is not accepted yet.

crit.description: Claims a verifier MUST understand; an unknown critical claim is refused (UNSUPPORTED_CRITICAL_CLAIM).

v2.description: Issue a protocol-V2 artifact (docs/protocol/PROTOCOL-V2.md; needs QODIQA_PROTOCOL_V2_ISSUE=true). The artifact then binds method, path, query, the listed headers and the body under JCS-P1 (requestHash over QODIQA::REQUEST::V2) and carries payload.qodiqa = { v: 2, kind: "request", bind, model?, limits?, crit? }.

ttl.description: Requested artifact TTL in milliseconds. Default and effective maximum: 60 000 ms (60 s) — verification refuses any artifact older than the 60 s maximum artifact age, so a larger value is CLAMPED to 60 s (never rejected; the response reports `meta.ttlClamped` and `meta.effectiveTtlMs`); values below 1 000 ms are raised to 1 000 ms; the signing identity `maxTtlMs` can only lower it (src/api/routes/sign.js).

expiresAt.description: Artifact expiry, Unix epoch milliseconds (= artifact.expiry)

effectiveTtlMs.description: TTL actually applied (requested ttl clamped to the 60 s maximum artifact age)

ttlClamped.description: true when the requested ttl exceeded the maximum and was clamped

decision.description: The decision of the audit DECISION entry of that request

entryHash.description: Hash of the audit DECISION entry (64 lowercase hex)

leafHash.description: RFC 6962 leaf hash of the transparency leaf registered for it (64 lowercase hex)

keyId.description: A TRANSPARENCY key id (never an artifact key)

signature.description: base64(Ed25519.sign(SHA-256("QODIQA::RECEIPT::V1" || JCS-P1(receipt without signature)))) — standard base64 of the 64-byte signature

id.description: Log sequence number (bigint, serialised as a string)

payload_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical payload

entry.description: The entry in camelCase form (transparencyId, id, entryType, payloadHash, entryHash, …)

root.description: The covering root in camelCase form (rootId, seqFrom, seqTo, rootHash, signature, …)

signature.description: Ed25519 over the root (present on GET /root, absent from list rows)

SigningApiKey.description:
Per-identity signing API key (TRUST-1 remediation).

`Authorization: Bearer sk_<64 hex chars>`

Every caller of POST /sign authenticates with its own individually-
issued, individually-revocable signing identity — there is no shared
secret. Issued via `POST /signing-identities/{id}/api-key` or
`scripts/provision-signing-identity.js`; stored as a SHA-256 hash —
the plaintext is shown **once** at issuance. Each identity is scoped
to one tenant, one deployment environment, and optionally a
restricted set of AI providers.
